items.title: UAE｜Dubai Islands岛B海岸工程合同落地，升级约3公里西岸线
items.title_en: UAE | Dubai Islands Island B marine works contract awarded for around 3 km western shoreline upgrade
items.summary: Nakheel已将Dubai Islands岛B的海事及沙滩工程授予Mar Marine & Building Contracting。工程包括新增约320米沙滩、升级约3公里西岸线、新建防波堤、拆除部分现有护岸石，并整修多个既有沙滩区域，计划于2027年第四季度完成。
items.summary_en: Nakheel has awarded the marine and beach works package for Island B at Dubai Islands to Mar Marine & Building Contracting. Scope includes around 320 metres of new beach, approximately 3 km of western shoreline upgrades, new breakwaters, removal of sections of existing revetment and rehabilitation of beach areas, with completion targeted for Q4 2027.
items.why_it_matters: 这是Dubai Islands持续开发中的明确施工包，并与住宅和基础设施项目形成连续供应链机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a confirmed execution package within the wider Dubai Islands development, adding to an active pipeline of residential and infrastructure works.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注防波堤、护岸石、海工混凝土、沙滩修复、排水、景观、照明、码头设施、施工设备及海工分包。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track breakwaters, revetment stone, marine concrete, beach nourishment, drainage, landscaping, lighting, marina facilities, construction equipment and marine subcontracting.

items.title: 沙特/UAE｜两国签署电网互联、电力交易及铁路连接合作MoU
items.title_en: Saudi Arabia / UAE | MoU signed on power-grid interconnection, electricity trade and rail connectivity
items.summary: 沙特与UAE于2026年10月8日签署合作备忘录，建立电网互联、电力交换与销售以及铁路连接合作框架，旨在加强两国能源和交通基础设施协同。
items.summary_en: Saudi Arabia and the UAE signed a memorandum of understanding on 8 October 2026 covering power-grid interconnection, electricity exchange and sales, and rail connectivity, creating a framework for deeper cooperation across energy and transport infrastructure.
items.why_it_matters: 这是大型跨境电力与铁路项目形成前端信号，一旦进入具体项目阶段，输电、变电、牵引供电、轨道及通信信号等需求体量可能很大。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is an early-stage signal for potentially large cross-border power and rail projects, with future demand likely across transmission, substations, traction power, track and signalling.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注变压器、GIS、开关柜、输电塔、导线、电缆、SCADA、牵引供电、轨道、通信信号及跨境EPC合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track transformers, GIS, switchgear, transmission towers, conductors, cables, SCADA, traction power, track, signalling and cross-border EPC partnerships.

items.title: 阿曼｜Musandam Aims Bay项目签署开发MoU，含滨水区、游艇码头和旅游设施
items.title_en: Oman | Musandam Aims Bay development MoU covers waterfront, marina and tourism facilities
items.summary: Musandam Governorate与Al Sarooj Development Company于2026年10月8日签署Aims Bay项目开发MoU，初步规划包括滨水开发、游艇码头、旅游及服务设施。
items.summary_en: Musandam Governorate and Al Sarooj Development Company signed an MoU on 8 October 2026 to develop the Aims Bay project, with preliminary plans including waterfront development, a marina, tourism facilities and supporting services.
items.why_it_matters: 项目处于形成期，后续有望释放海事、旅游、酒店、基础设施与公共空间等多类采购需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: The project is at formation stage and could generate future procurement across marine works, tourism, hospitality, infrastructure and public-realm packages.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注码头、海工、景观、照明、道路、MEP、酒店配套、游艇设施、家具、门窗及旅游商业配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track marina works, marine construction, landscaping, lighting, roads, MEP, hospitality packages, yacht facilities, furniture, doors and windows, and tourism-related commercial fit-out.

items.title: 摩洛哥｜Mohammedia港饮用水及消防管网升级工程新招标
items.title_en: Morocco | Mohammedia Port launches tender to upgrade potable-water and fire-protection networks
items.summary: 摩洛哥国家港口局发布Mohammedia港饮用水与消防管网升级工程招标，投标截止日期为2026年10月30日。
items.summary_en: Morocco's National Ports Agency has launched a tender to upgrade potable-water and fire-protection networks at Mohammedia Port, with bids due on 30 October 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 这是明确的港口水务与消防基础设施施工包，设备和安装需求直接，适合专业供应商及本地工程伙伴切入。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a clearly defined port utilities and fire-infrastructure works package with direct equipment and installation demand.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注管道、泵组、消防泵、阀门、消火栓、水箱、控制柜、SCADA、土建及港口安装施工。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Target pipes, pumps, fire pumps, valves, hydrants, tanks, control panels, SCADA, civil works and port installation services.

items.title: 西班牙｜Madrid–Extremadura高铁平台设计四个Lot新招标
items.title_en: Spain | Madrid–Extremadura high-speed rail launches four-lot platform design tender
items.summary: ADIF Alta Velocidad于2026年10月8日发布Madrid–Extremadura高铁Madrid–Oropesa段平台基础及施工设计招标，分为4个Lot，项目进入新一轮设计与施工准备阶段。
items.summary_en: ADIF Alta Velocidad launched a four-lot tender on 8 October 2026 for platform foundation and construction design on the Madrid–Oropesa section of the Madrid–Extremadura high-speed rail line.
items.why_it_matters: 项目进入新一轮设计与施工准备阶段，后续将继续释放土建、桥隧、轨道、电气化和专业设备包。
items.why_it_matters_en: The line is moving into another design and construction-preparation stage, with future opportunities expected across civil works, structures, track, electrification and specialist systems.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注高铁工程设计、桥隧、路基、轨道、接触网、电缆、信号、预制构件及西班牙本地工程合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track high-speed rail design, bridges and tunnels, earthworks, track, catenary, cables, signalling, precast components and Spanish engineering partnerships.

items.title: 墨西哥｜CRT准备启动智能无线通信网络招标
items.title_en: Mexico | CRT prepares tender for intelligent radiocommunication networks
items.summary: Proyectos México最新更新显示，墨西哥通信监管机构CRT正准备启动Intelligent Radiocommunication Networks招标，项目进入采购前端阶段。
items.summary_en: Latest updates from Proyectos México indicate that Mexico's communications regulator CRT is preparing a tender for Intelligent Radiocommunication Networks, placing the project at an early procurement stage.
items.why_it_matters: 这是数字基础设施项目形成前端信号，适合设备商和系统集成企业提前布局本地合作伙伴和投标准备。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is an early procurement signal for digital infrastructure, giving equipment vendors and systems integrators time to prepare partnerships and bidding strategies.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注无线通信、基站设备、专网、路由交换、光纤、调度系统、网络安全、系统集成及墨西哥本地ICT合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track radio communications, base-station equipment, private networks, routing and switching, fibre, dispatch systems, cybersecurity, systems integration and Mexican ICT partners.

items.title: 肯尼亚｜US$26亿国家基础设施基金开始部署资本
items.title_en: Kenya | National Infrastructure Fund begins deploying US$2.62bn seed capital
items.summary: Kenya National Infrastructure Fund已开始部署约US$2.62 billion种子资本，重点支持能源、交通、ICT、农业和水务等可商业化基础设施项目，并计划在2027年6月前推进资本部署。
items.summary_en: Kenya's National Infrastructure Fund has begun deploying about US$2.62 billion in seed capital to commercially viable projects across energy, transport, ICT, agriculture and water, with deployment targeted through June 2027.
items.why_it_matters: 基础设施资金池开始实际部署，有望加快肯尼亚多个项目从规划和融资阶段进入投资与执行阶段。
items.why_it_matters_en: The deployment of a dedicated infrastructure capital pool could accelerate multiple Kenyan projects from planning and financing into investment and execution.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注能源、道路、铁路、ICT、水务、农业基础设施，以及中国企业与肯尼亚本地开发商、基金和EPC合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track energy, roads, rail, ICT, water and agricultural infrastructure, plus partnerships between Chinese companies and Kenyan developers, funds and EPC contractors.
